items.q: How is this different from your maintenance plans?
items.a: Maintenance keeps your site running — updates, backups, monitoring, security. Support is the human layer on top: a named engineer you can talk to, edit hours for content and design changes, training for your staff, and integration help. Most practices bundle both.

Any content, small-design, or configuration work: updating provider bios, adding a service page section, swapping a hero banner, fixing a broken booking embed, changing insurance lists, uploading before-and-afters, publishing a blog post. Larger design or feature work is scoped separately.

items.q: How fast do you actually reply?
items.a: Live chat averages 42 seconds during business hours. Priority email is under 1 hour on Professional and Enterprise. Emergency site-down issues on Enterprise are escalated within 15 minutes, 24/7, to a named on-call engineer.

items.q: Do you support sites you didn't build?
items.a: Yes — WordPress, Webflow, custom, and headless dermatology sites. We start with a paid technical audit so we inherit your site safely and know exactly what we're supporting.

items.q: Can staff request edits, or only doctors?
items.a: Any team member you authorize. Most practices give access to the doctor, practice manager, and marketing lead. Every request is logged in the portal with a full audit trail.

items.q: What if I don't use my hours in a month?
items.a: Up to 50% of unused hours roll over one month. We'd rather you get the value than have to invent busywork — most clients use their hours and then some.
Month-to-month, cancel anytime. You keep all your content, code, credentials, and request history when you offboard.
